item.title: Assam Director Rima Das’ film ‘Not A Hero’ wins Special Mention Award at Berlin Film Festival
item.description: GUWAHATI: Renowned Assamese filmmaker Rima Das has earned global recognition at the Berlin International Film Festival 2026 as her coming-of-age film ‘Not A Hero’ has clinched a Special Mention Award. item.title: Rob Jetten Becomes Netherlands’ Youngest and First Openly Gay Prime Minister
item.description: GUWAHATI: Rob Jetten, 38, was sworn in on Monday, February 23, as the Netherlands’ youngest-ever prime minister, following a closely contested snap election that ended months of political uncertainty. item.title: Fake Tantrik Arrested After Duping Woman of Gold in Guwahati
item.description: GUWAHATI: Basistha police Monday, February 23, arrested a self-styled “tantrik” for allegedly duping a woman in Sankardev Nagar.
